_comment: 9944 Fog and low cloud in the Bryce amphitheater (R5 II CR3, 24 mm f/11 1/80 ISO 250; raw SO 8179x5455, cropped to 7157x4771 = 3:2). Final Camera Raw Filter read from the open document after the user saved the TIFF (the TIFF file itself was not re-opened from disk); its $LCs and $FltL are byte-equal to the state measured at the last pass. $BigT omitted: AI-mask bitmaps and the Denoise result live there (~57 million characters with denoise) and cannot be replayed headless, so this JSON documents values and mask recipes, it does not recreate the masks or the denoise. The Hero brush (see the card) was dropped by dialog sessions and is NOT part of the final state.

raw_so_manual.Temperature/Tint: unchanged (rock hue 56.7 deg; clouds slightly cool a* -1.9 b* -3.4 = aerial blue; foliage hue 91 = warm bounce)
raw_so_manual.Other: global Enhance > Denoise, amount 30 (user, in the filter dialog; key $FltL, tried 48 first); no Remove; no Lens Blur

ai_masks_user: Sky (Landscape 50006) - top cloud; used for Highlights -0.15, Texture +0.10; edge against the rock clean, misses some dark gaps in the cloud
Mountains (Landscape 50002) - all rock incl. pale cap and arches; probe +0.10 -> +8...+9 L*; NOT used (correction left at 0)
green trees (Color Range 1, parametric) - 92% of the dark forest pixels covered, 0.6% bleed into rock in the probe box

Hero - the user's radial gradient (uncropped box L 0.27295 R 0.866958 T 0.255899 B 0.654988) originally intersected with a user brush (Mask/Aggregate Brush 1, blend 1 inverted); the brush was dropped by two dialog sessions and finally deleted; final Hero = radial INTERSECT 'Rock tones only' Luminance Range 0.10/0.20/0.58/0.70 (scripted)
Pale cap and Right vignette - scripted parametric masks (radial INTERSECT Luminance Range), see the card

crop._note: window in full-frame (raw SO 8179x5455) coordinates, delete:false, committed in one call and read back
